ruleDefinitions.name: Powershell Sensitive File Discovery
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect adversaries enumerate sensitive files Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ls.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*get\\-childitem.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*gci.*")) AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-recurse.*") AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.pass.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.kdbx.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.kdb.*")))
